visual_review.01_frames: 6 separate frame/base pieces, no baked text, no overlap.
visual_review.02_bars: 3 track/fill pairs, red HP/cyan XP/amber Boss, no baked values.
visual_review.03_combat: 4 isolated pieces. Ammo arcs rendered as right semicircles (~180 degrees), not the prompted 90-degree span; retain raw source. Final arc span and track/fill alignment must be resolved in later authorized processing. Spinner is a single open-ring image for runtime rotation.
visual_review.04_markers: Player cyan heading arrow, enemy red diamond, chest amber chest; pause/swap/read pointer separate.
visual_review.05_weapons: Six distinct right-facing weapon categories. Details more elaborate than pure silhouette; small-size readability to be checked during later integration.
visual_review.06_portrait: Anonymous sealed helmet portrait; broad industrial silhouette. Surface detail more textured than flat glyphs; raw avatar draft, not a new character model.
visual_review.07_states: Empty timer plate, selected weapon ring, attachment read ring, neutral utility placeholder.
visual_review.08_modifiers: 12 distinct glyphs in documented order; front/back arrows point literal right/left. No text or rarity backplate.
